render.title: 3D rendering
render.assetsHint: Free photo textures (ambientCG, CC0) instead of the computed materials: plaster, parquet, grass, pavers… The style keeps its colours for the rest.

render.ambienceHint: Independent from the app's light/dark theme: « Automatic » follows the real sun above the house, from its GPS origin and the clock.
render.seasonHint: Tree foliage, blossom and fruit. « Automatic » follows the date, in the house's hemisphere.
render.projectionHint: « Flat » removes the vanishing point: parallel lines stay parallel, and you still orbit the house freely. « Isometric » also locks the angles — the 45° corner, a fixed pitch — and the view then only turns a quarter at a time; finger and left button pan it instead of rotating it.
render.qualityHint: Lamp glow, corner occlusion and anti-aliasing. « Automatic » picks from the machine, then steps down if frames cost too much.
render.weatherHint: Debug only: forces a weather onto the 3D scene to see it under rain or snow. The widget and the Weather view keep showing the real weather.
render.debugHint: Puts a measurement overlay on the scene: frames per second, CPU cost of a frame, draw calls, passes and shadow rebuilds. « img/s » at 0 when idle is normal — rendering is on demand.

tuning.title: Tune the light
tuning.hint: Tuning bench: presets, exposure, bloom, lamp glow and the selected room's outline, adjusted live in front of the house. The sliders multiply what the style computes — the day/night curve is kept. What you save is written to the house file and applies to every screen.

presetHints.soft: The same picture without the glare: only real sources bloom, the lamp halo is halved, the outline underlines instead of shouting.
presetHints.cinema: AgX curve: an overexposed lamp keeps its hue instead of turning white. Wider aperture, deeper vignette — a photograph.
presetHints.plain: For a hallway screen: almost no bloom, no vignette, a crisp opaque outline readable at a glance.
presetHints.model: The model-house spirit: still glowing, but lit walls stop bleeding.

render.houseEditingHint: The Home view then lets you adjust and drag windows and doors on the walls, lay out parking spots on the ground, and landscape the garden: trees, shrubs and stones to plant, move or remove. The wall survey is approximate: this is where it gets corrected. Nothing is written until something is actually adjusted.

ytmusic.importTitle: Import from a browser on the server
ytmusic.importSteps:
1. Keep Kasbah open here (this browser or another — not the YouTube Music one).
2. On the Kasbah host: normal Firefox/Chrome window (not private) → music.youtube.com → sign in.
3. Quit that browser completely (all windows), without signing out — private cookies vanish on close.
4. Pick the browser and Import.
On Windows, Chrome/Edge often fails (encryption) — prefer Firefox, or paste above.
ytmusic.anonymous: Without a cookie you search and listen anonymously: no likes, no playlists.
ytmusic.pasteHowTo:
1. Private window → music.youtube.com → sign in.
2. F12 → Network tab, then reload the page (F5).
3. In the Filter box, type browse, then click a browse?… request to music.youtube.com.
4. Headers tab → Request Headers section → cookie line: right-click → Copy value. Otherwise tick Raw and select everything after “cookie:”. The value is long and contains __Secure-3PAPISID.
5. Paste it below and Save. Do not sign out — just close the window.
Not the Application → Cookies tab: it lists cookies one by one, and you need the whole line.
ytmusic.renewHint: When the cookie expires: same procedure. On Windows, paste (F12 → Cookie) is most reliable; Firefox import may work. Quit Chrome/Edge for import; keep Kasbah open elsewhere.
ytmusic.poBad: PO Token generator unreachable — start it (port 4416): {url}.

pairing.title: First connection
pairing.step1: Turn the TENS on (green light), then hold the centre button for 3 seconds: the light blinks blue, it accepts a new device.
pairing.step2: Pair it from Windows: Settings → Bluetooth & devices → Add device → Bluetooth, then pick “acTENSv2_…”. Windows learns its name that way.
pairing.step3: Click Connect: the list then only offers “acTENSv2_…”.
pairing.step4: Without Windows: “Other devices”, then the “Unknown device” whose address starts with 00:30:3A.
pairing.flag: For Kasbah to reconnect by itself, without a click, even after a page reload: chrome://flags → “Web Bluetooth new permissions backend” → Enabled, then restart Chrome (or Edge: edge://flags).
pairing.note: The TENS keeps a single pairing: the phone will need pairing again to use the actiTENS app.

tens.cap: Cap: {max} mA per channel. Intensity rises in 0.5 mA steps.
tens.favoritesEmpty: No favorites: a program's star adds it, with the duration, channels and intensities set.
tens.targetHint: The session ramps up to these intensities on its own, in 0.5 mA steps; 0 = by hand. The star saves them with the favorite.
tens.localOnly: Controlled from this device only: neither automations nor other screens can reach it.
tens.unsupported: This browser does not speak Bluetooth. Open Kasbah in Chrome or Edge, on localhost or HTTPS.
tens.notEnabled: The TENS is not enabled on this device: Settings → On this device.

relief.title: Shape the terrain
relief.hint: Points appear on the terrain in the Home view: drag one up or down to raise or dig the ground there, the surface rounds off between points. The points under the house (paler) shape its surroundings: the ground can reach a wall without ever breaking through a floor. Around the pool it stays flat. The Outline tab changes the shape of the plot: its corners can be moved, added or deleted. Relief and outline are written to the house file.
relief.help: Tap a point to select it, then drag it up or down (it moves alone), or type its height. Anywhere else, dragging orbits the view. Pale points are under the house.

wizard.principle: Every measurement of the house starts from a point 0 you choose, usually an outside corner of the house. Place it on the map, then turn the heading so the first room (5 × 4 m, in blue) runs along a wall: x and y are the two measuring axes.

terrain.title: The land outline
terrain.text: Drag the corners, add some, or import the land register. Then “Done” in the land panel.

room.title: The first room
room.text: It sits on point 0. In the Dimensions tab, type its real measurements; add the other rooms from a chosen wall or “Rooms and levels”, then “Apply”.
